examples.en: We went out to sea on a fishing boat at dawn.
A fishing boat is coming into the harbor.

examples.ko: 낚싯배는 보통 열 명쯤 탈 수 있어요.
examples.en: A fishing boat can usually carry about ten people.
I caught a big sea bream on the fishing boat.
The waves were high, so the fishing boat rocked a lot.
I booked a fishing boat for this weekend.

explain: 낚시하는 사람을 태워 주는 배를 말할 때 많이 써요. 고기 잡는 일을 하는 배는 '고깃배'나 '어선'이라고 해요. 배를 세는 말은 '척'이에요.
explain_en: It is often used for a boat that takes people out to fish. A boat used for the fishing trade is a '고깃배' or '어선'. The counter for boats is '척'.

examples.en: What is the average starting salary for college graduates?
This company only hires college graduates.
Even college graduates find it hard to get a job.
They surveyed the pay gap between college and high school graduates.
The application requirement is a college degree or higher.

examples.ko: 요즘은 대졸자가 너무 많아져서 경쟁이 심해요.
examples.en: These days there are so many college graduates that competition is fierce.

explain: 구인 공고나 뉴스에서 많이 나오고, '고졸자'와 짝으로 자주 써요. 평소 말할 때는 '대학 나온 사람'이라고도 해요.
explain_en: It appears often in job postings and news, and pairs with '고졸자' (high school graduate). In casual speech people also say '대학 나온 사람'.

examples.en: I played rugby with my friends on the weekend.
Rugby has a lot of physical contact, so you have to be careful.
I wonder how rugby differs from soccer.
I like soccer and I like rugby too.
My younger sibling got into university through rugby.
My dad was a rugby player when he was a student.

explain: '축구'는 발로 공을 차는 경기이고, '럭비'는 손으로 공을 들고 달릴 수 있는 경기예요. 공 모양도 달라서 럭비공은 둥글지 않고 길쭉해요.
explain_en: In 축구 (soccer) you kick the ball, while in 럭비 you may carry the ball in your hands and run. The ball differs too: a rugby ball is long and oval, not round.

examples.en: I bought clothes whose colors go well together.
The name and the photo don't match.
The shoes go well with the bag, so it looks nice.
Once the information matches, the check is done.

examples.ko: 두 사람의 조건이 매치되었다는 연락이 왔어요.
examples.en: I got a message saying their conditions matched.
A message appeared saying the data doesn't match.

explain: 영어 match에서 온 말이라서 옷 색깔이나 정보가 맞을 때 써요. 옷이 어울릴 때는 '어울리다'로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요. 사람이 주어가 되어 직접 맞출 때는 '매치하다'를 써요.
explain_en: It comes from English 'match' and is used when clothing colors or pieces of information fit together. For clothes that suit each other, you can swap in 어울리다. When a person does the matching, use 매치하다.

examples.ko: 여름에는 아이들이 분수에서 물장난을 하며 놀아요.
examples.en: In summer, kids play and splash around in the fountain.

examples.ko: 아이들이 광장 분수 주변에서 물장난을 치며 놀고 있어요.
examples.en: The kids are playing with water around the fountain in the square.
We played with water in the tub, and the whole floor got wet.

examples.ko: 물장난이 너무 재미있어서 아이가 안 나오려고 해요.
examples.en: Water play is so fun that my child doesn't want to get out.

examples.ko: 아이는 수영은 못 해도 물장난만 해도 좋아해요.
examples.en: The child can't swim, but loves just splashing around.

examples.ko: 물장난 때문에 옷이 다 젖어서 갈아입었어요.
examples.en: My clothes got soaked from splashing around, so I changed.

explain: '물장난을 하다'나 '물장난(을) 치다'로 말해요. '물놀이'는 바다나 수영장에서 노는 것까지 넓게 가리키고, '물장난'은 물을 튀기며 장난치는 모습에 가까워요.
explain_en: You say '물장난을 하다' or '물장난(을) 치다'. '물놀이' is broader and includes playing at the sea or pool, while '물장난' is closer to playfully splashing water.

examples.ko: 천에 바늘구멍이 나면 물이 샐 수도 있어요.
examples.en: If a needle hole appears in the fabric, water may leak through.
Light came in through a gap as small as a needle hole.
Even a needle hole is small, wind still comes in through it.

examples.ko: 가죽에 바늘구멍을 너무 크게 내지 마세요.
examples.en: Don't make the needle holes too big in the leather.
This year the spots for passing are as narrow as the eye of a needle.

examples.ko: 바늘구멍 크기라도 그냥 두면 점점 커져요.
examples.en: Even a needle-sized hole gets bigger if you leave it.

explain: 실 꿰는 바늘의 구멍은 보통 '바늘귀'라고 하고, '바늘구멍'은 바늘로 뚫은 작은 구멍을 말할 때 많이 써요. 아주 작고 좁다는 느낌 때문에 비유로도 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: Competition is fierce, so passing is like getting through the eye of a needle.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기회나 통로가 아주 좁아서 들어가기 매우 어렵다는 뜻이에요. 취업·입시 이야기에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the chance or path is so narrow that getting in is extremely hard. Often used about job hunting and admissions.

explain_en: The eye of a sewing needle is usually called '바늘귀', while '바늘구멍' is often used for a tiny hole made by a needle. Because it feels so small and narrow, it is also common in comparisons.

examples.en: My heel got scraped because of the new dress shoes.
I tiptoed quietly with my heels raised.
In winter, my heels get dry and crack.
I put cream on my heels and put on socks.
The heel area hurt, so I went to the hospital.
I wore a long skirt that reaches down to my heels.

explain: 줄여서 '뒤꿈치', 또는 '발꿈치'라고도 해요. 신발의 뒷부분은 '뒤축'이라고 불러요. '발뒤꿈치를 들다'는 발끝으로 서는 느낌으로 쓰기도 해요.
explain_en: It is shortened to '뒤꿈치' or also said '발꿈치'. The back part of a shoe is called '뒤축'. Note that the phrase '발뒤꿈치를 들다' (raise your heels) is used for standing on your toes.

examples.ko: 감기에 걸려서 따뜻한 물에 벌꿀을 넣어 마셨어요.
examples.en: I had a cold, so I drank warm water with honey in it.
This honey has a strong scent and is sweet.
We ran out of honey, so I have to go to the mart.
I spread jam on the bread instead of honey.
I received snacks made with honey as a gift.
I mix honey and lemon to make tea.

explain: 그냥 '꿀'이라고 해도 같은 뜻이에요. 벌이 만든 꿀이라는 점을 분명히 하려고 '벌꿀'이라고 해요. 빵에는 '바르다', 물에는 '타다'를 써서 '물에 꿀을 타다'라고 해요.
explain_en: Just saying '꿀' means the same. 벌꿀 makes clear that it is honey made by bees. For bread you use '바르다', and for stirring it into water '타다', as in '물에 꿀을 타다'.

examples.ko: 하루 종일 봉사 활동을 해서 정말 보람찼어요.
examples.en: I volunteered all day and it was really worthwhile.

examples.ko: 보람찬 하루를 보내고 싶어서 일찍 일어났어요.
examples.en: I got up early because I wanted to spend a fulfilling day.
Teaching children is hard, but it is rewarding.
I made a plan to spend the vacation in a worthwhile way.
Preparing for the exam was hard, but passing makes it feel worthwhile.

examples.ko: 이 일은 월급은 적어도 보람차다고 생각해요.
examples.en: I think this job is rewarding even though the pay is low.

explain: 노력한 만큼 좋은 결과나 만족을 느낄 때 써요. '보람 있다'와 거의 같은 뜻인데, '보람차다'는 보람이 가득하다는 느낌이 조금 더 강해요. '보람찬 하루'처럼 꾸미는 말로도 많이 써요.
explain_en: You use it when your effort has brought good results or satisfaction. It means almost the same as '보람 있다', but '보람차다' feels a bit stronger, as if full of reward. It is often used to modify nouns, as in '보람찬 하루'.

examples.en: I made a pancake with garlic chives in it.

examples.ko: 부추는 향이 강해서 한 번에 조금만 넣어요.
examples.en: Garlic chives have a strong aroma, so I add only a little at a time.
These dumplings have garlic chives in them.
I bought a bunch of garlic chives at the mart.
Try adding a little garlic chives to the soup too.
On rainy days I think of garlic chive pancakes.

explain: 부추는 가늘고 납작한 잎이에요. '대파'는 굵고 하얀 줄기가 있는 다른 채소예요. 다발은 '단'으로 세요.
explain_en: 부추 has thin, flat leaves, unlike '대파', which has a thick white stalk. A bunch is counted with '단'.

examples.en: What is the spelling of this word?
The spelling was wrong, so I couldn't find it in the dictionary.

examples.ko: 제 이름 스펠링을 천천히 불러 드릴게요.
examples.en: I'll read out the spelling of my name slowly.
English spelling is hard to memorize.

examples.ko: 스펠링 하나만 틀려도 메일이 안 갈 수 있어요.
examples.en: Even one wrong letter can keep the email from being delivered.

examples.ko: 메일 주소 스펠링을 다시 확인해 주세요.
examples.en: Please check the spelling of the email address again.

explain: '철자'와 같은 뜻인데, 말할 때는 '스펠링'이 더 편하게 들려요. 한국어 글자의 규칙은 '맞춤법'이라고 해서 따로 불러요.
explain_en: It means the same as '철자', but '스펠링' sounds more casual in speech. The rules for writing Korean correctly are called '맞춤법', which is a separate word.

examples.en: I practiced like it was the real thing before the exam.
In the real situation I got nervous and made a mistake.
Try solving the practice-test questions.
She is a teacher with a lot of hands-on experience.
Practice and the real thing are very different.
Real-world practice matters for driving.

explain: '연습'과 짝으로 써요. 시험이나 경기처럼 진짜 해야 하는 순간을 말해요. '실전 문제', '실전 모의고사'처럼 시험 준비 책 이름에도 자주 붙어요.
explain_en: It pairs with 연습 as its counterpart. It refers to the moment you actually have to perform, like an exam or a match. It is also attached to study-book titles such as 실전 문제 and 실전 모의고사.

examples.ko: 아이큐 검사를 받았는데 결과가 꽤 높게 나왔어요.
examples.en: I took an IQ test and the result came out quite high.
I heard that child's IQ is over 150.

examples.ko: 아이큐와 공부 성적은 꼭 비례하지는 않아요.
examples.en: IQ and school grades don't necessarily go together.

examples.ko: 어렸을 때 학교에서 아이큐 테스트를 한 적이 있어요.
examples.en: I once took an IQ test at school when I was little.

examples.ko: 아이큐가 높다고 다 행복한 건 아니에요.
examples.en: Having a high IQ doesn't mean everyone is happy.

examples.ko: 퀴즈 프로그램에서 아이큐가 높은 사람들이 문제를 풀었어요.
examples.en: On the quiz show, people with high IQs solved the problems.

explain: 'IQ'라고 영어로 쓰기도 해요. '지능지수'가 정식 말이고, 일상 대화에서는 '아이큐'라고 많이 말해요. '높다/낮다'와 자주 함께 써요.
explain_en: It is often written in English as 'IQ'. '지능지수' is the formal term, while people usually say '아이큐' in daily talk. It commonly goes with '높다' (high) and '낮다' (low).

en: temples of a pair of spectacles

examples.en: My glasses' temple broke yesterday, so I taped it.

examples.ko: 안경다리가 너무 꽉 조여서 귀 뒤가 아파요.
examples.en: The temples are so tight that the area behind my ears hurts.
I bent the temples slightly to fit my face.
The child keeps grabbing and pulling the temples of my glasses.

examples.ko: 이 안경은 안경다리 색이 예뻐서 마음에 들어요.
examples.en: I like these glasses because the temples are a pretty color.

examples.ko: 안경다리 안쪽에 작은 글씨로 상표가 적혀 있어요.
examples.en: The brand name is written in small letters on the inside of the temple.

explain: 안경에서 귀에 거는 긴 부분이에요. 앞에서 렌즈를 감싸는 부분은 '안경테'라고 해서 서로 구별해요. 안경이 헐거울 때는 '안경다리를 조이다'라고 말해요.
explain_en: This is the long part of glasses that goes over the ear. The part that holds the lenses at the front is called '안경테', so the two are distinguished. When glasses are loose, people say '안경다리를 조이다'.

examples.en: If you sit in the front seat, you can see the board well.
Adults sit in the front seat of the car.
If you sit in the front seats at the cinema, your neck hurts.
The friend in the front seat waved.
The front seat on that bus is empty.

examples.ko: 콘서트는 앞자리 표가 제일 먼저 팔려요.
examples.en: For concerts, the front-seat tickets sell first.

explain: 교실·극장·버스처럼 자리가 줄지어 있는 곳에서는 '앞자리'가 자연스러워요. 차 안에서는 '앞좌석'이나 '조수석'도 써요. 반대말은 '뒷자리'예요.
explain_en: In places where seats are lined up, like classrooms, theaters, and buses, 앞자리 sounds natural. Inside a car, '앞좌석' (front seat) or '조수석' (passenger seat) is also used. The opposite is '뒷자리'.

examples.en: I haven't practiced enough, so I'm nervous about the presentation.
I'm increasing my amount of practice a little every day.
Before an exam, the more practice the better.
With piano, your skill depends on how much you practice.
If you reduce the amount of practice, your body is less tired.
I set my daily practice at two hours.

explain: '많다/적다', '늘리다/줄이다'와 함께 써서 연습을 얼마나 했는지 말해요. '공부량', '운동량'처럼 '-량'이 붙은 말이에요. 시간, 횟수, 쪽수 모두 연습량으로 셀 수 있어요.
explain_en: Use it with '많다/적다' and '늘리다/줄이다' to say how much you practiced. It works like '공부량' and '운동량'. Hours, repetitions and pages can all count as 연습량.

examples.ko: 아이가 이해력이 빨라서 한 번만 설명해도 알아요.
examples.en: The child understands quickly, so one explanation is enough.

examples.ko: 이해력을 높이려면 책을 많이 읽어야 해요.
examples.en: To improve comprehension you need to read lots of books.
Comprehension is really important in learning a foreign language.

examples.ko: 이해력에 비해 말하기 실력이 아직 낮아요.
examples.en: My speaking skill is still low compared to my comprehension.

examples.ko: 아이의 이해력 수준에 맞는 책을 골랐어요.
examples.en: I chose a book that matches the child's level of comprehension.

examples.ko: 그 사람은 말도 잘하고 이해력도 좋아요.
examples.en: That person speaks well and also understands things well.

explain: '이해력이 빠르다/느리다/좋다/부족하다'처럼 말해요. 글을 읽고 이해하는 힘은 '독해력'이라고 해서 따로 있어요. 이해력은 말, 설명, 상황까지 넓게 쓸 수 있어요.
explain_en: You say '이해력이 빠르다/느리다/좋다/부족하다'. The ability to read and understand text has its own word, '독해력'. 이해력 is broader and covers speech, explanations and situations.

examples.en: This translator has quite high accuracy.

examples.ko: 일기 예보의 정확도는 예전보다 많이 좋아졌어요.
examples.en: The accuracy of weather forecasts has improved a lot compared with before.

examples.ko: 정확도를 높이려면 데이터를 더 모아야 해요.
examples.en: To improve accuracy, we need to collect more data.
Speed matters, but accuracy matters more.

examples.ko: 이 앱의 위치 정확도는 몇 미터쯤 될까요?
examples.en: About how many meters is the location accuracy of this app?

examples.ko: 채점 정확도 때문에 답안을 두 번 확인했어요.
examples.en: For the sake of grading accuracy, I checked the answer sheets twice.

explain: '정확성'이 정확한 성질을 말한다면 '정확도'는 얼마나 정확한지 정도를 말해요. 그래서 '정확도가 높다/낮다'처럼 쓰고 번역, 예측, 검색 같은 이야기에 잘 나와요.
explain_en: While '정확성' is the quality of being accurate, '정확도' is the degree of how accurate something is. So you say '정확도가 높다/낮다', and it fits talk about translation, prediction and search.

examples.en: An old tank is on display at the museum.
In the movie, a tank rolled into the village.

examples.ko: 아이가 탱크 장난감을 갖고 싶어 해요.
examples.en: The child wants a toy tank.
The car's fuel tank is almost empty.
There is a water tank on the roof of the house.
The soldiers took a photo next to the tank.

explain: 탱크는 군사용 전차를 말할 때도 쓰고, 물이나 기름을 담는 큰 통을 말할 때도 써요. 통의 뜻일 때는 '물탱크', '연료 탱크'처럼 앞에 무엇이 들어 있는지를 붙여요. 군용 차량을 정식으로는 '전차'라고도 해요.
explain_en: 탱크 means a military tank and also a large container for water or fuel. For the container meaning, the contents go in front: '물탱크', '연료 탱크'. The formal word for the military vehicle is '전차'.
